Exam Regulation

Section 1. Attendance
Students must attend all scheduled examinations unless excused in advance by the academic office.

Section 2. Missed Exams
If a student misses an examination without prior approval, the result is recorded as a fail. A retake may be permitted only when documented illness or emergency is submitted within five working days.

Section 3. Retakes
Approved retakes are scheduled in the next examination period. Only one retake is allowed per course per academic year.
